answers.answer: On arrival was not given information on dinner, bed and breakfast arrangements and allowances. Also, I was not advised that there was a service charge on drink and food. This would’ve helped in knowing that the great staff do get a tip as part of our bill at the end of the stay. We were not aware of this although it is hidden away somewhere in the terms and conditions as part of our confirmation that was sent in an email. This needs to be highlighted on the reservation detailed page not lower down lost in the terms and conditions. Also it should be made clear that on the autumn break there is an allowance for the evening meal. The amount is not stated in any information that we received and was also not communicated to us at check-in or prior to having our meal on the evening. We are several times for clarification on what we were entitled to and were told anything on the menu. However, on departure we had a £34 extra charge. I agreed to pay half of this. £17 however on reflection this should be removed due to the lack of information given and also a very clear statement made before we selected our menu choices that everything was included. I would like the £17 refund to my Credit Card as soon as possible. Also, I think that some improvements to the process would be to include the allowance on the website booking system and also highlight that the staff do receive a 10% discretionary tip in the booking system as well. We were very pleased to tip the staff for their excellent service.

answers.answer: Would be reluctant to stay again. Rachel did her best to compensate but despite the room upgrade the room was so noisy. Our subsequent stays at a Hilton and Marriott were much quieter. Highlight was our massages - Carris was excellent, best massage I’ve ever had.

answers.question: What could have been improved?
answers.answer: Quieter room, not changing our booking, better spa facilities - you market Wood Hall as a spa hotel but there is no sauna and a very small steam room. In fact when I first made the booking there were no treatments available. I was subsequently called back and advised a masseuse was now available.
